text: On 19 January 2023 Jon lost a banking job and decided to start a business: a dance studio, driven by a lifelong passion for dancing and a wish to share it with others.
In January 2023 Gina lost a job at Door Dash. Gina named dance as the go-to stress relief, and Jon called dancing a passion and an escape that Jon has loved since childhood.
Jon has loved dancing since childhood, treating dance as a passion and an escape, and plans to open a dance studio to teach others the joy that dance brings Jon.
Jon's favorite dance style is contemporary, which Jon described as expressive and powerful. Gina also named contemporary as a favorite, calling it expressive and graceful.
Jon suggested going to a dance class and invited Gina to see Jon's moves next Friday (27 January 2023). Gina agreed to explore new dance moves together at a dance session.
Jon's dance crew took first place in a local competition in 2022, a moment Jon described as amazing on stage. The photo Jon shared in the conversation came from that win.
Jon said Jon is super keen to spread the intensity of performing on stage to other people, and asked Gina whether Gina had been in any dance competitions or shows.
Gina competed in a few dance competitions and shows. Gina's favorite memory is the team winning first place at regionals at age fifteen, which Gina described as an awesome feeling of accomplishment.

Gina's team performed a contemporary piece called 'Finding Freedom', which Gina described as really emotional and powerful. Gina also shared a photo of a large open porch with a fireplace and a view of the water.
Jon shared a photo of an ideal dance studio by the water, a room with an ocean view and a few yoga mats, and said Jon hopes to find a place that inspires the group like it.
Gina asked Jon whether Jon had time to rehearse with a business and a new store. Jon replied that Jon hopes to find a place like the studio in the photo that will inspire the group.

Jon rehearses after work with a small group of dancers who perform all kinds of dance, from contemporary to hip-hop. Jon was finishing choreography for a performance at a nearby festival in February 2023.
The dancers Jon showed in a photo are the group performing at the festival. Jon said they have been practicing hard and will impress the audience with their grace and skill.
Gina said Gina was excited to see the festival performance and that the dancers will rock the festival. Jon agreed and said Jon is glad to be part of it.
As of 29 January 2023 Gina had just launched an ad campaign for the clothing store to grow the business, and Gina described starting and running the store as both scary and rewarding.
Jon said Gina's store looked great and congratulated Gina on the hard work paying off. Gina said seeing the vision come to life is awesome.
As of 29 January 2023 Jon was still hunting for the ideal dance studio spot. Jon had found a downtown place with great natural light, and downtown was easy to get to.
Jon visited Paris on 28 January 2023, the day before, and called it sooo cool. Gina said Gina had never visited Paris and had only been to Rome once.
Jon wants a dance floor with enough bounce for Jon and Jon's students to dance safely, and Jon plans to check the size and floor quality of the studio before deciding.
Jon chose Marley flooring for the dance studio, the flooring dance studios usually use, because it is grippy yet lets dancers move and is tough and easy to keep clean.
Gina agreed that dance floors help avoid injuries and called Marley flooring perfect, saying it has the right amount of grip and movement for dancing.
Jon described finding the right place and getting everything ready as a mix of exciting and nerve-wracking, and said Jon is determined to make the studio work.
Gina encouraged Jon to take breaks and dance it out to destress. Jon said Jon has to make time to dance and vent, and that Gina is in Jon's corner.
Jon and Gina urged each other to keep chasing their dreams. Gina said good things are coming, and Jon replied that success is almost here.
On 1 February 2023 Jon said Jon's dance studio search has been bumpy but Jon is determined, and Jon is still searching for a place to open the studio.
On 1 February 2023 Gina said a wholesaler replied yes that day, which lets Gina expand the clothing store and get closer to customers. Gina shared a photo of a shopping mall entrance.
Jon praised Gina's new store space as the perfect spot for the store and shared a photo of a room with a mirror and a wooden floor.
Gina said the store space was designed to be cozy and inviting, with comfy furniture and a chandelier that adds a glam feel matching the store's style.
Gina said the cozy design makes customers feel comfortable, and Jon said Gina's customers will be so comfy in the store.
Gina wants customers to feel like they are in a cool oasis and to have an experience that makes them want to come back to the store.
Jon said the special customer experience Gina imagines is achievable, and Gina said hard work and effort would make the shopping experience special for customers.
Gina told Jon that the dance studio would succeed if Jon kept going, and Jon replied that staying positive and pushing forward would make the studio happen.
On 4 February 2023 Gina said the clothing store is doing great and is a wild ride. Jon said Jon is putting a lot of work into the business despite obstacles.
On 4 February 2023 Jon said searching for a dance studio location had been tricky, but Jon was determined to find the right spot, after which the rest would follow.
Gina said finding the perfect dance studio is a tough job and urged Jon to hang in there, since a spot would be found soon.
Jon said Jon is working on the business and on new dance routines, rehearsing hard for an upcoming show. Jon shared a photo of a woman in a gray dress doing a trick.
Jon said a dance competition near Jon is coming up next month, March 2023, a chance to show skills and earn respect from the dance community.
Gina said Gina expects Jon to do well in the competition and wished Jon good luck. Jon thanked Gina and promised to make Gina proud.
Gina told Jon that setbacks are opportunities for comebacks and that Jon has the skills, passion and drive, plus Gina's full support.
Jon said it is hard when things do not go Jon's way, but with Gina's support Jon can handle anything.
Gina said Gina is always there for Jon no matter what and asked Jon to share anything new about the business.
Jon said Jon won't give up on reaching Jon's dreams, and Gina told Jon to keep going and believe in himself, saying Jon has got this.
Gina's advice to Jon was to keep positive and focused, and Jon said Jon appreciates Gina's kind words and encouragement, which mean a lot.
On 8 February 2023 Gina said Gina had found a new fashion piece for the store and shared a photo of women posing with a giant balloon to share with customers.
Gina said Gina had been working hard on the online store and teamed up with a local artist for cool designs, inspired by a fashion magazine and a lack of similar pieces.
Jon said the festival performance Jon had mentioned earlier was awesome, with many people complimenting Jon's dance moves, and that dancing brings Jon joy.
Jon said running a studio gives Jon the freedom to create a space and help dancers of all ages and levels express themselves, and seeing students progress is fulfilling.
Jon said taking risks got Jon out of a secure 9-5 banking job, and Jon now aims to turn dancing into a business, admitting it has not been a walk in the park.
Gina said Gina got a tattoo a few years before 8 February 2023 that stands for freedom, dancing without worrying what people think, as a reminder to follow passions.
Gina said freedom to express oneself without worry is important, and Jon agreed that dance gives Jon an escape to be oneself.
Gina said a quote kept Gina positive through tough times. Jon shared a photo of a trophy with a glass globe on top and promised to keep working hard on dance.
Jon said juggling dance and the business works because dance energizes the business goals, and business successes boost Jon's drive on the dance floor.
Gina said dancing lets people be themselves and that nothing matches the feeling it gives, and Gina encouraged Jon to chase dreams.
Gina asked Jon how Jon juggles dance and business goals, and Gina said finding a happy medium is key and urged Jon not to stop dreaming.
Jon said Jon won't give up on the dance studio and business ventures, which need hard work, and Gina said Gina is always there for Jon.
Jon said Jon started hitting the gym the week of 6 March 2023 to stay on track with the venture, and that balancing it all is a challenge but going well.
Gina said that since losing the Door Dash job things had been tough, though good news was coming. Jon offered help, and Gina thanked Jon for the offer.
As of 16 March 2023 Gina's online clothing store was open, a dream Gina had held for a while. Gina shared a photo of a computer screen showing a book and a pair of shoes.
Jon congratulated Gina on the online store and asked what gave Gina the idea to start it. Gina said Gina is passionate about fashion trends and finding unique pieces.
Gina said the online store came from a wish to blend Gina's love of dance and fashion, which made a perfect match for the business.
Jon said starting the business has been tough, but Jon is going to make it, facing new challenges that Jon is sure will be worth it in the end.
Gina said starting and running the business has had ups and downs but has been an amazing ride. Jon said Gina's determination inspires Jon to keep pushing forward.
Jon and Gina said they face the same challenges, which motivates both of them like having a dance partner, and Gina said both are on different paths but rooting for each other.
Jon raised a toast to taking on new heights and the trials that come with it, sharing a photo of two glasses of champagne with a bottle of wine.
On 23 March 2023 Gina said the online clothing store had been a roller coaster but rewarding, and that starting a business takes courage, urging Jon to hang in there.
Gina said Gina keeps up with fashion trends so the store can offer the best pieces to customers, and that running it takes a lot of work but Gina is enjoying it.
Jon advised Gina that brand identity is key, that building relationships with customers and letting them know Gina cares matters, and that staying positive and motivating others helps.
Gina said building relationships and a strong brand image for the store is an ongoing focus, and agreed that staying positive is key.
Jon said seeing students succeed motivates Jon, and Jon shared a photo of a group of women doing a dance routine from one of the dance classes.
Gina said seeing students grow and succeed must be fulfilling, and Gina is glad to be part of Jon's dance studio journey.
Jon said Gina's support means a lot and that Jon is grateful for the help with staying motivated, and Gina said Gina is rooting for Jon all the way.
Gina told Jon to never give up and to believe in himself even when it is tough, and Jon said Jon won't quit and will keep believing in Jon.
On 3 April 2023 Jon told Gina that Jon had shut down the bank account because it was needed for the business, a tough call Jon thought would help the business grow.
On 3 April 2023 Gina said the online store had new offers and promotions to bring in new customers, and Gina said Gina is not giving up on the business.
Gina said customers love the new offers and promotions, which means more sales, and that growing the customer base is the main focus right now.
Gina planned to work with fashion bloggers and influencers over the next few months and run more ads, aiming to make the store a top destination for fashion fans.
Gina said dance is Gina's stress relief and fashion fuels Gina's creativity. Combining the two lets Gina share a love of both and add dance-inspired items to the store.
Gina shared a photo of a man and woman doing a yoga pose, which Gina called a fave dance session, and Jon said that was great.
As of 3 April 2023 Jon was expanding the dance studio's social media presence and offering workshops and classes to local schools and centers.
Jon said the dance studio is hosting a dance competition next month, May 2023, to showcase local talent and bring more attention to the studio, and the dancers are excited.
Jon invited Gina to the studio's event next month, a night of performances and judging from the dance studio and other schools, and Gina said Gina was definitely in.
Gina said the event sounded great and that Gina would love to join in and show support. Jon said Jon can't wait to see Gina there.
Jon asked Gina to attend the event and said Jon is trying to make the plan work even though it has been tough, with Gina's encouragement a real help.
Gina said on 3 April 2023 that Gina is so proud of Jon's progress and encouraged Jon to keep it up.
Jon said Jon won't quit on Jon's dreams and that Gina's words motivate Jon, and Gina said Gina hopes Jon keeps pursuing goals.
On 9 April 2023 Jon said Jon is turning a love of dance into a business, has put tons of time into the studio lately, and is even learning alongside the students.
Jon said losing the job was tough but gave Jon the push to do what Jon loves, and Jon is determined to make the studio work.
Jon said dancing makes Jon very happy and seeing students improve brings Jon joy, and Gina said Jon looks so happy when dancing.
Jon said Jon used to be scared of what people would think, but learned that personal happiness matters most, and that dance is Jon's way to express and find a happy place.
Jon loved taking lessons with friends when younger, says those memories are precious, and is glad to enjoy dance with Jon's own studio.
Gina said Gina used to love spending time in the studio and remembers those dance classes. Gina shared a photo of a group of young women in ballet attire.
On 9 April 2023 Gina shared a photo of one of Gina's trophies from a dance contest, a reminder of hard work, dedication and the joy dance brings.
Gina told Jon that Jon earned all the kudos for the hard work and urged Jon to keep it up, and Jon said Jon won't let anything hold Jon back.
On 25 April 2023 Jon said that the day before, 24 April 2023, Jon went to a fair to show off the studio. It was stressful and great, and produced some possible leads.
Jon said running this business is no cakewalk and that having confidence in yourself is important for making it successful, as Jon reflected on the fair.
Gina said Gina started an online clothing store not long before 25 April 2023, and that after losing the job Gina wanted to take control of Gina's own destiny.
Jon asked Gina for advice on staying motivated when times are tough. Gina said Gina stays motivated by focusing on the big goal, getting support from others and dancing it out.
Jon said Jon has been feeling low on confidence and asked how to stay confident in business. Gina advised reminding oneself of successes and focusing on why Jon started, because Jon loves it.
Gina told Jon that Jon is incredibly talented and passionate about dance, urged Jon to believe in Jon's abilities and tackle any obstacle, and Jon said Jon will keep going to reach dreams.
Gina and Jon agreed to keep pushing each other on the business path, with Gina saying they are in this together and can do it.
On 11 May 2023 Jon said the dance studio is still in progress and things are looking up. Jon described losing the job as the push to finally start Jon's dream business.
Jon said Jon is stepping into the unknown with the studio and hoping for the best, and that dancing has been Jon's stress-buster since childhood.
Jon said dancing helps Jon de-stress, is where Jon feels most alive, and is a must-have in Jon's life. Gina said dance is Gina's stress fix too.
Gina said Gina cannot picture life without dance, describing it as like air, and that dance is how Gina looks after mental health.
Jon said Jon is living the dream of having a dance studio and teaching others, and wants to create a place for people to dance and express themselves.
Gina said that on 11 May 2023 Gina had an interview for a design internship the day before, 10 May 2023, which Gina called so cool.
Jon said Jon has been practicing dance routines lately, which keeps Jon's mind focused and motivated, and Jon offered to send Gina a video of one routine.
Gina said Gina will watch Jon's routine and is so proud of Jon, and Jon said Jon would send the video soon.
Jon said Jon would keep Gina posted on the dance studio's progress, and Gina said Gina appreciated being kept in the loop on the project.
Gina said the studio will totally change things for lots of folks, and Jon said Jon hopes so and wants the studio to be a place for people to express themselves.
On 27 May 2023 Gina said Gina had just been accepted for a part-time fashion internship in the fashion department of an international company, a big change that Gina feels excited and nervous about.
Gina said Gina is a mix of excited and scared to get into fashion and is trying to stay upbeat and learn as much as possible.
On 27 May 2023 Jon said Jon is reading The Lean Startup, hoping it would give tips for the business, and that it got Jon thinking about building a focused, efficient business.
Jon said adapting and tweaking from customer feedback is important and that Jon plans to try it. Jon shared a photo of a whiteboard with a list of dates.
Jon uses a whiteboard with dates to keep track of ideas and milestones, which gives Jon a visual of progress and keeps Jon organized.
Jon said Jon is wrapping up the business plan and looking for investors, driven by passion for the project and belief in its success.
Gina said Gina was impressed by Jon's commitment and asked how the investor hunt is going. Jon said searching for investors has been tough but Jon is staying hopeful.
Jon said Jon is learning a ton from the investor process and won't let anything get Jon down, and Gina said obstacles are inevitable but awesome things can still be done.
Jon said Jon will keep going and never quit, and shared a photo of a pink sign with a message on it when saying so.
On 13 June 2023 Jon said Jon is prepping for the dance studio more than ever and thanked Gina for believing in Jon, saying Gina's support means a lot.
On 13 June 2023 Gina said Gina had developed a video presentation teaching how to style fashion pieces, and agreed to send it to Jon later.
Jon said working with young dancers and seeing their passion and commitment is inspiring, and Jon wants the studio to be a place of support and encouragement.
Jon said Jon offers one-on-one mentoring and training to help dancers reach their full potential, in addition to dance classes and workshops.
Gina said Gina had a mentor too when learning how to dance, and Jon said a mentor can do wonders, with guidance and support helping dancers shine.
Jon said Jon uses a notebook with a calendar to stay organized and motivated, setting goals, tracking achievements and finding areas to improve.
Jon also uses a whiteboard to stay on track, visualize goals and tokenize successes, and color-codes achievements so Jon can track progress and stay motivated.
Gina said color-coding is a great way to track progress and stay motivated, and Jon said it helps Jon stay motivated and reminds Jon why Jon is doing this.
Gina encouraged Jon to keep staying positive and not quit on dreams, and Jon said Jon won't give up and will keep pushing to make dreams happen.
On 16 June 2023 Jon said Jon was mentored by a business person the day before, 15 June 2023, which made Jon even more pumped to chase dreams.
On 16 June 2023 Gina said Gina is working on the online store to grow the customer base, which is tough but Gina is determined.
Jon said Jon has been promoting the business, a crazy ride so far that Jon is hanging in there with, and asked Gina for marketing tips.
Gina advised Jon that marketing is key and suggested using social media channels and working with influencers for bigger reach.
Jon said Jon had already started posting some of Jon's dance videos on social media after Gina's advice, and the videos are creating a bit of a stir.
Gina said Gina became an entrepreneur after losing a job, opened an online clothing store, and said being one's own boss and doing something loved is awesome.
Gina's advice for someone starting out is to stay passionate, focused and resilient, believe in oneself, keep going and stay open to learning and improving.
Gina shared a photo of a group of young women posing from Gina's dancing days, saying it was a tough road but worth it, and that failures lead closer to success.
Jon said Jon won't quit and that Gina's encouragement keeps Jon motivated. Jon said the dance photo reminds Jon how much Jon loves performing.
On 19 June 2023 Jon said Jon took a short trip to Rome the week before, the week of 12 June 2023, to clear Jon's mind a little, and Jon is still working on opening the studio.
Jon said the official opening night of the dance studio is tomorrow, 20 June 2023, and Jon is working hard to make everything just right.
Gina said the studio looked amazing and that Gina was pumped for the launch on 20 June 2023, urging Jon not to miss a beat.
Jon said Jon was excited and felt good and ready to give the grand opening Jon's best, after a wild ride of work.
Gina said Gina would be right by Jon's side at the grand opening and shared a photo of a group of people in a dance studio.
Jon said Jon would savor every second of the opening night on 20 June 2023 and thanked Gina for always having Jon's back.
Gina said Gina loves being around friends, can't wait to have fun at Jon's dance studio, and can't wait for tomorrow's grand opening.
Gina told Jon that Jon earned the good feels for the opening night, and Jon said Gina's pride and support mean a lot.
Gina told Jon to capture the joy and thrill that dance brings and said Jon has come so far since they last talked.
Jon said Jon looks forward to enjoying the moment with Gina and making more cool memories at the grand opening, and Gina said Gina can't wait to make more memories at the studio.
On 21 June 2023 Gina said Gina had acquired new unique pieces for the clothing store and shared a photo of a woman in a black hoodie.
Gina said the camouflage hoodie shown is from Gina's own collection and is not for sale. Gina made a limited edition line the week before, the week of 12 June 2023.
Gina said the hoodie design reminds Gina of the grit it takes to stand out and face challenges.
Jon said Jon chose yesterday, 20 June 2023, to go to networking events to make things happen, and that it has been tough but Jon is staying determined and focused.
Jon said losing the job has been tough, but investing time in the business will pay off eventually. Gina told Jon 'You got this!' and offered to help with anything.
Jon said Jon is writing all Jon's plans down, and that seeing goals on paper keeps Jon motivated and focused on what Jon has to do.
Gina said tracking plans and goals is key and is like a picture of all one's progress, and Gina urged Jon to keep persevering and working hard.
Jon said a sign reading 'never give up' reminds Jon to never give up however hard things get, and Jon said Jon feels confident and won't give up.
On 9 July 2023 Gina said Gina had been noticed by fashion editors the week before, the week of 2 July 2023, which was amazing but scary and added pressure to keep growing.
On 9 July 2023 Jon said Jon is going full-time with the business idea, since losing the job pushed Jon to take the plunge toward Jon's business dreams.
Jon said Jon has been learning marketing and analytics tools to push the business forward, which is tricky, but Jon is up for the challenge.
Jon said Jon is excited to guide and mentor aspiring dancers, and Gina said Jon would be the perfect mentor and guide, whose positivity will make the studio a hit.
Jon said dance has the power to bring people together and that moments like these remind Jon why Jon is chasing the dream and keep Jon pushing through struggles.
Gina told Jon that stumbling blocks can be opened doors, that a solid community is cheering Jon on including Gina, and that Gina is rooting for Jon.
Jon said Gina's faith in Jon is a real boost and that Jon won't let anything or anyone stop Jon from making dreams come true, and Jon thanked Gina for being a great friend.
Gina told Jon that Jon has potential and that Jon's dreams are so close, and Jon said Jon won't quit even when it is hard.
Gina said Gina is always here to cheer Jon on, and Jon said being on Gina's side is a comfort during the journey.
On 21 July 2023 Gina said Gina built a new website for customers to place orders the week before, the week of 10 July 2023, and Gina is loving the wild ride.
On 21 July 2023 Jon said the dance studio is on tenuous grounds, and Jon took a temp job to help cover expenses while Jon looks for investors.
Gina said sourcing trendy pieces was a big hurdle for the store, and that research and networking helped Gina solve it, with networking described as a lifesaver.
Gina advised Jon not to be scared to reach out to people in the field for help and contacts, saying networking opened Gina up to products Gina might not have found otherwise.
Jon said networking has got Jon some good stuff, and Jon shared a photo from the last networking event, a group of people standing in a room.
Jon said the networking event was awesome, Jon met investors and got good advice, and the energy was motivating and gave Jon a boost to pursue goals.
Jon said Jon is sprucing up the business plan and tweaking the pitch to investors, and is working on an online platform to show off the dance studio's offerings.

Gina suggested Instagram and TikTok for reaching a younger crowd, posting dance clips, and collaborating with local influencers or dance communities, and offered to help make content and manage accounts.
Jon said Jon would appreciate Gina's help making content and managing Jon's social media, and Gina agreed to create cool content and manage the accounts.
Jon and Gina agreed to collaborate on the dance studio's social media and to teach others to chase dreams, with both saying they can do amazing things together.
On 23 July 2023 Jon said Jon had been rehearsing hard and working on business plans, which has been stressful, but dancing has kept Jon going.
Gina urged Jon to 'just do it' and shared a photo of dancers on a stage with their arms in the air. When Jon asked whose words they were, Gina said they belong to Shia Labeouf.
Gina said a creative space for dancers is so important, and that Gina felt this at dance class with a group of friends last Friday, 21 July 2023.
Gina told Jon the studio will be a go-to spot for self-expression. Jon said Jon can't wait until the studio welcomes dancers of all ages and backgrounds.
Gina said Gina is happy to see Gina's words motivating Jon, and told Jon every step gets Jon closer to the dream and to never give up.
Jon thanked Gina for the encouragement that keeps Jon motivated, and said Jon won't quit and is going to keep going whatever comes Jon's way.
Gina reminded Jon to just do it, and Jon laughed and replied JUST DOING IT.
